8.7.3 Application specific ErrorHook
[SWS_Os_00540] Definition of configurable interface ErrorHook_<App> ⌈
Service Name
ErrorHook_<App>
Syntax
void ErrorHook_<App> (
StatusType Error
)
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
Error
The error which caused the call to the error hook
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
The application specific error hook is called whenever a Task or Category 2 ISR which belongs
to the OS-Application causes an error.
Available via
Os_Externals.h
⌋
If the general ErrorHook is configured, the general ErrorHook is called before the
application specific error hook is called (see [SWS_Os_00246]).
[SWS_Os_00544] ⌈Availability of ErrorHook_<App>: Available in Scalability Classes
3 and 4.⌋
